concerns.text: FR-009 introduces an 'inconsistency tolerance threshold' and a sensitivity sweep over absolute differences {0.01,0.05,0.1}. The original idea does not request any such threshold analysis; it only asks whether the sunspot‑TSI relationship varies across cycles and to achieve a ≥15 % error reduction.

FR-008 mandates execution on a CPU‑only environment with ≤7 GB RAM. The idea statement contains no hardware or runtime constraints; this is an engineering limitation that was not part of the research scope.

FR-002 adds a 'low‑activity proxy' (fixed value based on the 2008–2019 minimum) for gaps ≥1 year, beyond the idea’s simple linear interpolation for missing values. The idea does not specify this additional proxy handling, so the requirement extends the scope.
